thread:
john_acme: Hey team — seeing structured JSON responses from the API stream get cut off mid-object when using SSE behind our proxy. Examples from our prod client attached, parse errors on final brace. Request id: r-0a1b2c3d.

sam: thanks — can you paste a minimal curl repro? also any proxy hops (CF, nginx) in front of you?

john_acme: repro below. we hit the hosted endpoint with SSE and my client fails to parse final JSON object ~15% of streams. proxy chain: customer app -> corp-gw -> cloudflare -> redwood-hosted.

john_acme: ```
curl -v -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \n  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams?model=x"
```

john_acme: sample chunked output we got (truncated):
```
data: {"id":"abc123","choices":[{"delta":{"content":"{\"items\":[{\"id\":1,\"text\":\"ok\"},\"\n\"}"}}]}
```

john_acme: notice trailing comma and newline then socket FIN. client parse error: "Unexpected end of JSON input"

support_bot: Created ticket SUP-4321, assigned to lifecycle queue.

sam: copying eng-runtime (ingrid) and ops. @ingrid any idea? We can repro with the curl above but need to know if this is server side or proxy.

ingrid: looking. quick guess: last chunk being delivered as a partial flush due to proxy keepalive/heartbeat trimming the final bytes. When SSE payloads are chunked and the server doesn't send a terminating newline or final event, some proxies may coalesce/trim buffers on connection end.

ingrid: can you attach the exact raw bytes (hexdump) of the last few chunks? also any intermediate proxy logs showing `FIN` or `RST`?

john_acme: attached hexdump and their CF trace id: cf-trace-99. I also saw `downstream closed` in corp-gw logs. Hex shows stream ended with `...
\"text\":\"ok\"},\"` — so the final `]}}` missing.

sam: confirmed reproducible locally with curl --no-buffer. if you run `curl --no-buffer` you see the JSON object cut mid-string ~1s before final event.

ingrid: action items: (1) ops to check proxy buffer/timeout settings (proxy_buffering, proxy_send_timeout) and any keepalive probes that may trigger early close. (2) runtime: make SSE emitter ensure objects are emitted as complete top-level JSON tokens followed by a newline and final `data: [DONE]` event. Also add a small sentinel boundary to detect mid-object closure.

ops_lead: I'll check corp-gw and cloudflare settings. staging already has `proxy_buffering on;` — we'll try toggling off for /v1/streams and bump timeouts.

ingrid: thanks. on runtime I'll add a fix to flush final boundary in the next deploy and add extra retry logic on truncated JSON (best-effort remerge) and a regression test.

john_acme: will verify after action steps. ping me when ready. thx :thumbsup:

sam: raising this to P1 for now given customer parse errors. updating SUP-4321 with repro steps and assigning to ingrid + ops_lead.

support_bot: SUP-4321 status changed -> escalated.

ingrid: quick note — temporary workaround for clients: buffer stream until you see the final `data: [DONE]` event or a blank `event: close` then parse. That avoids partial-parse crashes.

john_acme: using that now, reduces errors. keep me posted on deploy.
